🚩 Report Bullying

A safe, confidential space to report bullying. Every report is taken seriously.

🔒 Your safety matters. All reports are treated with strict confidentiality. You may report anonymously.

Submit a Bullying Report

What Happens After You Report?

1
Confidential Review

Your report is reviewed confidentially within 48 hours by our safeguarding team.

2
School Notification

The relevant school principal or safety officer is notified and required to take action.

3
Support Offered

A counsellor or support person is made available to affected learners.

4
Follow Up

If you provided contact details, we will follow up on the outcome of your report.

Emergency Contacts

📞 Child Line South Africa: 0800 055 555 (Free, 24/7)
📞 SAPS Crime Stop: 0860 010 111
📞 Foundation Safeguarding: 015 000 1234
💌 Email: safeguarding@vhubvaduvha.org.za

🌟 Youth Opportunities

Bursaries, learnerships, internships, jobs and programmes for young people

🏫

NSFAS Bursary 2025

Full bursary for qualifying students pursuing university or TVET college education. Covers tuition, accommodation and meals.

Bursary Deadline: 31 Jan 2025 Open
🎓

Vhubvaduvha Foundation Bursary — Engineering & Education

25 full bursaries available for students from Vhembe pursuing degrees in engineering, education or health sciences at South African universities.

Bursary Deadline: 28 Feb 2025 Open
🔧

Eskom Learnership Programme 2025

Eskom is offering electrical engineering learnerships for Grade 12 graduates. NQF Level 4 qualification upon completion. 18-month programme.

Learnership Deadline: 15 Mar 2025 Open
💼

Government Internship Programme (DPSA)

The Department of Public Service and Administration offers 12-month internships for graduates in various government departments. Monthly stipend provided.

Internship Deadline: 28 Feb 2025 Open
👨‍💻

Microsoft Digital Skills for Africa

Free digital literacy and coding programme for youth aged 16-35. Certificate issued upon completion. Online and in-person options available.

Programme Ongoing Free
🏢

Community Health Worker Positions

The Limpopo Department of Health seeks 50 Community Health Workers for the Vhembe District. Matric required. Training provided. Stipend: R4,000/month.

Job Deadline: 20 Mar 2025 Open
🏥

National Health Learnership — Nursing Aid

24-month nursing learnership offering NQF Level 3 qualifications for aspiring healthcare workers. Stipend and uniform provided.

Learnership Deadline: 30 Apr 2025 Open
🏈

Foundation Sports Development Programme

Vhubvaduvha Foundation sports bursaries for talented athletes in football, basketball and athletics. Covers training costs and competition entry fees.

Programme Applications: Mar 2025 Athletes
